description: A chronic condition where tissue similar to the uterine lining grows outside the uterus — on ovaries, fallopian tubes, and pelvic tissue. Affects ~10% of women of reproductive age. Average diagnosis delay is 7-10 years.

staging.stage_1_minimal: Small implants, shallow endometriosis, no significant adhesions
staging.stage_2_mild: More implants, slightly deeper, minor adhesions
staging.stage_3_moderate: Many deep implants, small endometriomas on ovaries, some adhesions
staging.stage_4_severe: Many deep implants, large endometriomas, dense adhesions

pain: Pain with bowel movements or urination during period
other: Infertility — affects ~30-50% of those with endometriosis

medications: NSAIDs — ibuprofen 400-800mg taken before period starts
Progestin-only methods (Mirena IUD, depo shot, mini-pill)
GnRH agonists (Lupron) — induce temporary menopause, short-term use
Dienogest (Visanne) — progestin specifically studied for endometriosis

surgical.excision_surgery: Gold standard — complete excision of endometrial lesions. Provides longest pain relief and best fertility outcomes
surgical.ablation: Burns lesion surface — less effective than excision, higher recurrence
surgical.hysterectomy: Last resort; does not guarantee cure as endometriosis can remain on other organs

fertility_treatments: Laparoscopic excision before IVF improves outcomes
IVF is often recommended for endometriosis-related infertility
Ovarian reserve monitoring (AMH, AFC) important due to endometrioma damage

diet: Anti-inflammatory diet — reduce red meat, processed foods
Gluten-free diet helps ~75% of endometriosis patients with GI symptoms
supplements: NAC — shown to reduce endometrioma size in studies
other: Stress reduction important — cortisol affects estrogen

important_notes: Stage does not correlate with pain severity
Endometriosis is estrogen-dependent — treatments that reduce estrogen help
There is no cure — management is ongoing
Seek an endometriosis specialist (excision surgeon) for best outcomes
when_to_see_doctor: If you have severe period pain, painful sex, or are struggling to conceive — push for investigation even if initially dismissed
